cover.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a finished literary fantasy book cover for the short story "Catch Me". Portrait 9:16 composition, 864x1536. The supplied orchard painting is only a visual reference for the collection's oil-paint handling: Canadian Group of Seven inspired, broad rhythmic colour/value shapes, varied directional opaque strokes, some selective impasto, quieter connecting passages, connected dark shadows and lost edges. Reinterpret that painted medium for this entirely new urban fantasy subject; do not retain orchard content.
At street level on an ordinary small-town cinema street at evening, Peony is a small magical girl who appears thirteen but is actually forty-seven. Pink curls, a broad expressive young face, determined protective expression, puffed pink sleeves, a modest knee-length pink magical dress, opaque pale tights, practical pink boots with one small heart on each, and pink gloves with one small stitched heart. She stands planted, hands open and ready to catch someone just beyond the image. Great painted peony petals gather protectively around her hands and near the pavement, a sense of enormous controlled strength in a small figure. Let ordinary care and ferocity coexist; natural anatomy, no glamour or sexualization. A striped cinema canopy recedes to one side and a low wall beside an ordinary car is faintly visible; high overhead a dark wooden cabinet shape with a single side-hinged glass door and carved crest is suggested in shadow, an ominous shape rather than a detailed monster portrait. No other people, no wings on Peony, no fireballs, no guns, no gore. The cover should invite the story, not summarize its entire plot.
Motivated evening light with muted rose, cream, brick and connected charcoal/violet shadows; avoid neon glow, glossy anime rendering, theatrical rim lighting, uniform orange-blue contrast. Clear spacious typography in the upper quarter: render the exact title "Catch Me" ONCE in elegant readable cream serif letters painted into the cover; no other text, no author name or borders. Keep all title letters within safe margins.
Requested original file destination: D:/.codex/worktrees/7a6a/story-computing-machine/tmp/art/catch-me-cover.png. This is a new cover derived from the supplied painting's medium, never modify the source reference.
